name: City Horizon Building LOD / Gameplay Scale Gate
purpose: Ensure authored buildings remain legible at the gameplay zoom ranges used by the desktop city builder before production export.

levels.intent: silhouette and broad material separation must remain readable
roof, wall mass and primary facade modules must remain visually distinct
full authored material and facade detail must remain readable

rule: A production building package is blocked when any distant, medium or close gameplay-scale profile fails its silhouette, visible-area or contrast threshold. The LOD gate evaluates readability only and never creates alternate gameplay sprites or changes footprint, anchor, facade geometry or road sockets.
